content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment for road builders and quarries; no irrigation or highway barrier products."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and coatings for commercial construction; no irrigation or highway safety overlap."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Sells farm machinery and precision agriculture software through independent dealers to farmers, matching Lindsay's irrigation business model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Municipal street sweepers, sirens and warning lights; different products, though sold to public agencies."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Industrial pumps, valves and seals sold to process plants; no center pivot irrigation or highway safety products."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt plants and burner systems for paving producers; no irrigation or highway barrier business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Industrial pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors for process and rail customers; not irrigation or road safety."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rail track components and precast concrete for railroads; does not make highway guardrail or crash cushions."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"General-purpose pumps for water, fire and industry; agricultural pumps differ from center pivot irrigation systems."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Makes highway guardrail and crash cushions sold to state and federal transportation agencies, matching Lindsay's road safety business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers and water quality instruments; different products and customers from irrigation and barriers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Commercial plumbing fixtures and drinking water products for buildings; no agricultural irrigation or highway safety overlap."}]}
